author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam and Norm unbox and react to Corridor Crew's latest project: a 3D-printed diorama showing the in-camera practical effect of moving forced perspective as used in Lord of the Rings! This awesome model perfectly details how the production filmed Gandalf and Bilbo in the same room without visual effects, and lets you film a similar shot using a phone camera! 

We build Corridor Crew's Moving Forced Perspective Diorama: https://youtu.be/LY2MuGbnu9c
Print Corridor Crew's diorama with files here: https://makerworld.com/en/models/2784006-corridor-crew-forced-perspective-diorama
Watch the design and making of this diorama: https://youtu.be/fERSX9oV0kE
Corridor Crew's original moving forced perspective video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MVUuoXAkuUg

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
